src:
MOV     AH, 2Fh          ; DOS: get the DTA in ES:BX
INT     21h
MOV     OLDOFS1, BX
MOV     OLDSEG1, ES
MOV     DX, OFFSET ATM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AX, OLDOFS1
CALL    PHEX             ; 0080
MOV     DX, OFFSET INPSP1
MOV     AX, CS
CMP     AX, OLDSEG1      ; in a .COM, CS is the PSP
JE      SAY1
MOV     DX, OFFSET OTHER1
SAY1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 1Ah          ; DOS: the DTA is DS:DX from now on
MOV     DX, OFFSET DTA1
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 2Fh          ; ask again
INT     21h
MOV     DX, OFFSET NOWM1
CMP     BX, OFFSET DTA1
JE      SAY2
MOV     DX, OFFSET OTHER1
SAY2:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
PUSH    CS               ; 2Fh changed ES
POP     ES
MOV     AH, 1Ah          ; and the DTA back where it was
MOV     DX, 80h
INT     21h

OLDOFS1 DW      0
OLDSEG1 DW      0
ATM1    DB      "DTA at $"
INPSP1  DB      " in our PSP", 13, 10, "$"
OTHER1  DB      " somewhere else", 13, 10, "$"
NOWM1   DB      "DTA now at our buffer", 13, 10, "$"
DTA1    DB      128 DUP(0)
PHEX    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX as four hex digits (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, AX
MOV     CX, 4
PHEX1:
PUSH    CX
MOV     CL, 4
ROL     BX, CL           ; the top digit to the bottom
POP     CX
MOV     DL, BL
AND     DL, 0Fh
ADD     DL, "0"
CMP     DL, "9"
JBE     PHEX2
ADD     DL, 7            ; "A" to "F"
PHEX2:
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PHEX1
RET
PHEX    ENDP
